title: Patbingsu Red Bean Shaved Ice

seo.metaDescription: Learn how to make authentic Patbingsu (Korean Red Bean Shaved Ice) at home! This easy Patbingsu recipe features sweet red beans, condensed milk, and chewy rice cakes. Perfect for summer!

seo.imageCaption: Cool down with a refreshing bowl of Patbingsu, the iconic Korean shaved ice dessert, made easily at home!

description: Patbingsu is a beloved Korean shaved ice dessert, perfect for cooling down on a hot day. This refreshing treat features a mountain of finely shaved ice, generously topped with sweet red bean paste and a drizzle of condensed milk. Its delightful combination of textures and flavors makes it an iconic Korean dessert.

instructions.title: Prepare the Milk Ice Base
instructions.text: Pour the whole milk into shallow freezer-safe containers or ice cube trays. Freeze for at least 4-6 hours, or preferably overnight, until completely solid. This milk ice will create a creamier shaved ice base than plain water.

instructions.title: Prepare the Sweet Red Bean Paste
instructions.text: If using canned red beans, drain and rinse them. In a small saucepan, combine the red beans with 1/4 cup sugar and a splash of water. Simmer on low heat for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sugar dissolves and the beans are slightly softened and mashable. Mash lightly with a fork or potato masher to your desired consistency. Let it cool completely.

instructions.title: Prepare Tteok (Rice Cakes)
instructions.text: If using dried mini tteok, boil them in water for 2-3 minutes until they become soft and chewy. Drain and rinse with cold water to prevent sticking. If using fresh tteok, simply separate them. Set aside.

instructions.title: Shave the Milk Ice
instructions.text: Remove the frozen milk from the freezer. Using a shaved ice machine or a sturdy food processor with a shaving attachment, shave or finely crush the milk ice until it resembles fluffy snow. Work quickly to prevent it from melting.

instructions.title: Assemble the Patbingsu
instructions.text: Divide the shaved milk ice into four individual serving bowls, forming a generous mound in each. Create a slight well in the center of the ice mound for your toppings.

instructions.title: Add Toppings and Serve
instructions.text: Spoon a generous amount of the cooled sweet red bean paste over the shaved ice in each bowl. Arrange the prepared mini tteok and any optional toppings like fruit cocktail or a scoop of ice cream on top. Drizzle generously with condensed milk. Serve immediately and enjoy!

tips: For the fluffiest shaved ice, ensure your milk is completely frozen solid. A good quality shaved ice machine makes a big difference.
Customize your Patbingsu with various toppings like fresh fruit (strawberries, kiwi, mango), cereal flakes, or a sprinkle of roasted soybean powder (injeolmi garu).
To prevent the ice from melting too quickly, chill your serving bowls in the freezer for about 15-20 minutes before assembly.
